objective: Implement thumbnail-first autoplay on BUKLOD Wall and Marites video surfaces, suppress black flashes and startup play indicators, and preserve native controls/ad lifecycle.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source SHA 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f inspected 2026-11-22. This is source-only evidence, not proof of the installed app, active Android runtime, AdMob delivery or production OTA.
chosenApproach: Keep the existing expo-video textureView + first-frame callback for Wall; overlay a stable neutral backdrop and private thumbnail until the frame renders. Marites uses the same poster cache, bounded upload preview sidecars, near-viewport frame capture and delayed nonblocking loading indicator. Do not touch IMA, AdMob SDK, backend SQL or native configuration.
selectionRationale: A source-ready player can still show its native black surface before a frame is decoded; readiness/playing events do not guarantee a rendered first frame. Existing Marites rows lacked signed thumbnail propagation and used a manual-play placeholder.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Change only poster overlays, load indicators and video autoplay/control behavior within existing Android community media components.
preservedBehaviors: Preserve tab/navigation lifecycle, AppState pause semantics, player reuse, consent and AdMob placements without changing native runtime.
No Expo config or native module changes, no release workflow edits and no OTP/authorization changes.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add first-frame cover and private video previews to Marites feed and viewer while respecting signed media and existing video cache limits.
preservedBehaviors: Preserve public Wall media visibility, Marites 72-hour feed filters, owner edit/delete controls, upload fallback and native IMA ad lifecycle.
Private poster metadata remains scoped to existing author-verified media RPC and storage policy.

preserveBehaviors: Wall/Marites scrolling stops videos immediately; offscreen warm preloading remains bounded.
Keep foreground AppState, fullscreen swipe/navigation, media authorization, upload cleanup, retries and app-wide ad/consent policies.
No New Native binary or Season2 material, no production or staging OTA publication.
acceptanceChecks: Run changed static regression test and existing community video poster, first-frame, handoff, scroll, ad and navigation tests.
Required Engineering Accountability protected-feature gate passes with exact scope manifest.
Android cold swipe, missing preview, weak network and fullscreen gestures require on-device QA before release.
Commit identity and staging runtime compatibility must be verified before any staging or production OTA.
alternativeApproaches: Keep showing native VideoView immediately: rejected due to black flashes before first frame.
Mount an extra player per card to capture posters: rejected for memory, battery and network cost.
Publish unverified production OTA: rejected by permanent release gates.
